The lazy alternative — classifying manual hides as promoted/featured to reuse the cosmetic bypass — is rejected: it would corrupt label semantics and labelBlockedPosts membership.
architectureChoice.choice: separate manual-hide wrapper sharing restoration and placeholder behavior
architectureChoice.rejected: A minimal explicit reason inside blockPost: it would reuse the hide path but require isManual guards in six counting-adjacent conditionals (counted/blockedCount, dailyCounts, patternCounts, badge, lastBlocked, suggestions) plus storage persistence — every missed guard leaks manual hides into spam stats. The wrapper keeps the no-count/no-persist/no-undo invariant structural instead of conditional.
